{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Drop rows with missing flipper_length_mm for the mean calculation
# We only need flipper_length_mm for this computation, so dropna on that column
filtered_df = df.dropna(subset=['flipper_length_mm'])

# Compute mean flipper length by species
mean_flipper_by_species = filtered_df.groupby('species', as_index=False)['flipper_length_mm'].mean()

# Sort by mean flipper length in descending order
mean_flipper_by_species_sorted = mean_flipper_by_species.sort_values(by='flipper_length_mm', ascending=False)

# Get the species with the highest mean
highest_mean_species = mean_flipper_by_species_sorted.iloc[0]['species']

# Print results
print(mean_flipper_by_species_sorted)
print(f'\nSpecies with the highest mean flipper length: {highest_mean_species}')"}
